name: Super Kappy Island
detailed_description:
Escape from a fast-paced life and find refuge on an island full of peaceful and hungry capybaras. Super Kappy Island is a cozy game that mixes adventure and exploration, with moments of relaxation and interactions focused on your relationship with the capybaras of the island.

This is a classic top-down game, with 16-bit graphics and an original soundtrack composed especially for the game.

Once you arrive on Kappy Island, you can farm, fish and meet the locals while collecting resources to transform the world around you. Travel through randomly generated caves full of enemies and bosses with unique mechanics, where each exploration will bring new paths full of resources to improve your island, your home and train your companions.

No FOMO! On Kappy Island, nurturing good relationships with the local capybaras will keep your garden healthy and your energy bar full so you can choose the best time to do your activities – this means you can play without fear of running out of energy mid-game, and you’ll even be rewarded if you prefer a more regimented playstyle, cooking and sleeping regularly.

If you enjoy collecting animals, you’ll gather adorable companions with special powers that help you in battles and unlock new mechanics. These pets can also be upgraded throughout your adventure.

Inspired by games like Animal Crossing, Cozy Grove, A Short Hike and Cult of the Lamb.
